source_observations.result: S05 keeps the existing ScrollView, release and feature identities, navigation link, and feature.symbolName; adds centered 680-point content width and size-based bounce. Existing eager VStack is unchanged, with no introduced query or per-row I/O.

S05 stacks actual version and feature row content at accessibility sizes. Title gains vertical growth and summary is unlimited only at accessibility sizes; original icon, badge, combined accessibility element, and ordinary three-line summary remain.

S06 keeps existing image/symbol artwork path and navigation. At accessibility sizes the header stacks icon, text, and version badge; ordinary horizontal header retains its Spacer. Detail content gets centered 680-point content width.

independent_boundaries: S05 and S06 are conceptually independent and touch separate view types in the same Swift file. S05 owns the top-level dynamicTypeSize property and release/row hunks; S06 owns its private detail dynamicTypeSize property and detail hunk. Separate commits or PRs are technically feasible with hunk-level patches, but the supplied patch is combined and should be treated as one source change if both screens ship together.
